content:
Subject: Request to Tidy Up Vendor Agreements Inbox

Hi Assistant,

Could you please tidy up the Vendor Agreements inbox? Once you’ve completed that, send a one-paragraph reply to the Records list describing which threads you archived.

Thank you!

Best,  
[Your Name]

I tried to open the "Vendor Agreements" folder but I don’t see any emails there. Before I make changes, could you confirm two quick things?

1) Do you mean the mailbox label/folder literally named "Vendor Agreements", or should I look for vendor/agreement/contract threads across your Inbox (and Sent)?  
2) What are your criteria for "tidy up"? For example:
   - Archive all threads older than X months/years (suggestion: archive >2 years old), or  
   - Archive threads labeled “final” or “completed”, or  
   - Archive all threads that have no unread messages and no action items, or  
   - Another rule you prefer?

If you want, I can proceed with a suggested default: find messages in Inbox/Sent with keywords vendor OR agreement OR contract, then archive threads older than 24 months and report back. If that works, I’ll also send the one-paragraph reply to the Records list (please confirm the Records list email address — is it records@company.com?) describing which threads I archived.

You can also tell me to go ahead with a different rule and confirm the Records address; I’ll then perform the cleanup and send the summary.

Please search for vendor/agreement/contract threads across my Inbox and Sent, and archive threads older than 2 years. The Records list email is records@company.com. Thank you! 

[END]
